phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Beretta 92FS Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 9×19mm Parabellum primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 240 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 240 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 125 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the 6-groove bore and accelerates to 381 m/s (540 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Locking Block Drop & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, straight-line barrel recoil actuates a falling locking block that drops clear of the slide recesses.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 15-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Beretta 92FS staged for its 60 RPM (practical semi-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪：1976 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 意大利贝雷塔 92FS（美军制式代号 M9）以极具辨识度的敞顶大开口套筒彻底杜绝“烟囱卡壳”故障；其下落式对称闭锁卡铁令枪管仅沿水平轴直移后坐，结合铝合金底把与双排 15 发弹匣服役美军三十余载。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Beretta 92FS 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1976 年问世的 贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪 由意大利法布里卡·达尔米·彼得罗·贝雷塔（Beretta）主导研制，定位为经典的敞顶套筒卡铁摆动式手枪。1985 年贝雷塔 92F 击败西格 P226 赢得美军 XM9 竞标并更名为 M9，成为继柯尔特 M1911 之后美军列装时间最长的制式手枪。
意大利贝雷塔 92FS（美军制式代号 M9）以极具辨识度的敞顶大开口套筒彻底杜绝“烟囱卡壳”故障；其下落式对称闭锁卡铁令枪管仅沿水平轴直移后坐，结合铝合金底把与双排 15 发弹匣服役美军三十余载。 整件装备总长 217 mm（8.5 in）、空重 0.945 kg，成为同期手枪左轮领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1976 年，意大利法布里卡·达尔米·彼得罗·贝雷塔（Beretta）推出了划时代的贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪。1985 年贝雷塔 92F 击败西格 P226 赢得美军 XM9 竞标并更名为 M9，成为继柯尔特 M1911 之后美军列装时间最长的制式手枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于敞顶开放式套筒结构大幅减重并实现近乎零阻塞的 180° 抛壳通道，奠定了其在手枪左轮发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 精密铣削往复式钢制套筒

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪 的机械灵魂在于其「枪管短后坐 · 瓦尔特式下落闭锁卡铁 · 双动/单动外露击锤」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，枪管保持直线短后坐，下方卡铁块在解锁销驱动下垂直下沉释放套筒，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。下落式对称闭锁卡铁使枪管直线后坐，天生具备极高的轴向射击精度，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪 采用枪管短后坐 · 瓦尔特式下落闭锁卡铁 · 双动/单动外露击锤。在每个击发周期中，枪管保持直线短后坐，下方卡铁块在解锁销驱动下垂直下沉释放套筒。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了下落式对称闭锁卡铁使枪管直线后坐，天生具备极高的轴向射击精度。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 9×19mm Parabellum 弹药规格与 125 mm（4.9 in 镀铬直动枪管 · 6 条右旋 · 1:250 mm），最高工作膛压约 240 MPa，可赋予弹头 381 m/s 的出膛初速与 540 J 动能，有效作用距离达 50 米。
内膛技术特点方面，125 mm 镀铬 6 条右旋膛线，击发后枪管纯水平直移不上下偏转。同时，套筒两侧对称解脱保险杆集待击解脱（Decocker）与阻铁锁止于一身，令其在 60 发/分（实用半自动） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 125 毫米身管与 9×19mm Parabellum 口径，贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪 实现了每秒 381 米的初速与 50 米有效射程。125 mm 镀铬 6 条右旋膛线，击发后枪管纯水平直移不上下偏转，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 15 发容量的15 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 34 mm 膛轴设计，贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 3.1 N·s 水平。FS 改进型加装加大击锤轴盘，彻底防止高压弹致套筒后段飞脱。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-81）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 15 发容量的15 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，FS 改进型加装加大击锤轴盘，彻底防止高压弹致套筒后段飞脱。欢迎在 BAY-81 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 贝雷塔 92FS（美军 M9）半自动手枪 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Beretta 92FS
paragraphs: Introduced in 1976 by Fabbrica d’Armi Pietro Beretta in Italy, the Beretta 92FS / U.S. M9 Pistol emerged as a defining Open-Slide Falling-Block Service Pistol. Winning the US XM9 trials in 1985 to become the M9, the Beretta 92 series succeeded the Colt M1911A1 and remained the US military’s standard sidearm for over 30 years.

Adopted as the US military M9 for over three decades, the Italian Beretta 92FS pairs a signature open-top slide that virtually eliminates stovepipe jams with a Walther-inspired falling locking block allowing strictly linear, non-tilting barrel travel. Measuring 217 mm (8.5 in) at an unloaded weight of 0.945 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Handgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1976, Fabbrica d’Armi Pietro Beretta of Italy introduced the Beretta 92FS / U.S. M9 Pistol. Winning the US XM9 trials in 1985 to become the M9, the Beretta 92 series succeeded the Colt M1911A1 and remained the US military’s standard sidearm for over 30 years. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Signature open-top slide minimizes reciprocating mass and eliminates stovepipe jams — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Beretta 92FS / U.S. M9 Pistol sits its Short-Recoil Non-Tilting Barrel · Falling Locking Block · DA/SA Exposed Hammer. Throughout every firing cycle, straight-line barrel recoil actuates a falling locking block that drops clear of the slide recesses, containing 240 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Falling symmetrical locking block enables strictly straight-line barrel recoil, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Beretta 92FS / U.S. M9 Pistol relies on Short-Recoil Non-Tilting Barrel · Falling Locking Block · DA/SA Exposed Hammer. During each cycle, straight-line barrel recoil actuates a falling locking block that drops clear of the slide recesses. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Falling symmetrical locking block enables strictly straight-line barrel recoil.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 9×19mm Parabellum with 125 mm (4.9 in Chrome-Lined Straight-Recoil · 6-Groove RH · 1:250 mm), the Beretta 92FS / U.S. M9 Pistol develops 381 m/s muzzle velocity and 540 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 50 meters.

Internally, 125 mm chrome-lined 6-groove RH barrel recoiling strictly linearly without tilting. Combined with its 60 RPM (practical semi-auto) tempo, Ambidextrous slide-mounted safety-decocker safely drops the hammer onto a firing-pin block, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 9×19mm Parabellum through its 125 millimeter bore, the Beretta 92FS / U.S. M9 Pistol achieves 381 meters per second and 50 meters of effective reach. 125 mm chrome-lined 6-groove RH barrel recoiling strictly linearly without tilting.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 15-round 15-round detachable magazine body with a 34 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 3.1 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. FS-series enlarged hammer-pin disc prevents rearward slide separation under extreme loads.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-81), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.
